- `/root/ab-run-p1/repo/engine/crates/xerj-api/src/router.rs:407` — `.route("/:index/_bulk", post(es_compat::bulk_ops))`

`/root/ab-run-p1/repo/engine/crates/xerj-engine/src/bulk.rs:802`
```rust

```

```rust

```

`/root/ab-run-p1/repo/engine/crates/xerj-engine/src/bulk.rs:1779`
```rust

                    .clone()

```



`/root/ab-run-p1/repo/engine/crates/xerj-engine/src/bulk.rs:325`
```rust
    let lines: Vec<&str> = body.lines().filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()).collect();
```

  ```rust

                              "index has reached the field limit of {limit}; \
  ```

**Defaults (`impl Default for LimitsConfig`, `/root/ab-run-p1/repo/engine/crates/xerj-common/src/config.rs:1588-1600`):**

| Limit | Default | Site |
|---|---|---|
| `max_body_bytes` | `100 * 1024 * 1024` (100 MiB) | config.rs:1593 |
| `max_actions_per_bulk` | `50_000` | config.rs:1591 |
| `max_fields_per_index` | `500` | config.rs:1590 |

The ES-compat rewrite pass pairs lines naively; the engine pairs them with a delete heuristic. On any malformed action line the two diverge, shifting every subsequent document onto the wrong action metadata.

